common.slogan: A minimalistic note-taking app for everyone.

devtools.description:
Please close the developer tools!
If someone told you to copy/paste something, it is a SCAM and will compromise your account security.

noAccess.title: AI access required
noAccess.description: You don't have access to this AI feature yet. Please ask the administrator to grant it.

roster.title: Persona roster
roster.emptyHint: Create your first persona to start interviewing.
roster.confirmArchiveBody: The persona will be moved to Archived. Its data and interview transcripts are kept and can be restored later.

form.name: Name
form.regionHint: Any region within the persona's country — e.g. Northern Vietnam, Saigon. The AI ignores values that don't fit.
form.tagsHint: Province/city, circumstances… Type to pick an existing tag or add a new one.
form.stanceHint: Suggestions: cooperative / guarded / talkative / suspicious — free description also works.
form.bioOfflineError: Could not reach the AI assistant. Please try again later.
form.bioError: Something went wrong while drafting the bio.
form.noAccessError: You don't have access to this feature.
form.seedHint: Paste or write a paragraph describing the person to interview — the AI treats it as the source of truth and fills in the rest.

chat.title: Interview
chat.blockedHint: Generate a system prompt for this persona first — then come back to start the interview.
chat.emptyState: Ask your questions in Vietnamese — this persona replies in Vietnamese.
chat.offline: Could not reach the AI assistant. Please try again later.
chat.genericError: Something went wrong during the interview. Please try again.
chat.noAccessError: You don't have access to this feature.
chat.deleteConfirmBody: This interview session and its conversation will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
chat.actionFailed: The last action failed. Please try again.

profile.emptyBio: No bio yet — open Edit and generate one.
profile.emptySystemPrompt: No system prompt yet — open Edit and generate one before starting an interview.

run.title: Batch runs
run.scriptHint: One question per line. Use Detect questions to pull them out of a pasted list or paragraph.
run.scriptPlaceholder:
1. How do you usually start your day?
2. What was the last purchase you hesitated over?
3. Who do you ask first for advice?
run.extractFailed: Could not detect questions. Try again with different text.
run.detectOverwrite: Replace the current questions with the detected ones?
run.contextHint: Optional — briefly explain the interview's purpose so personas understand why they're asked.
run.contextPlaceholder: e.g. A consumer study on everyday shopping habits. Your answers are anonymous and never read aloud.
run.personasHint: Only active personas can be selected.
run.personaNoPrompt: No system prompt — will be skipped
run.empty: No active personas yet — create personas first.
run.createError: Could not create the run. Check the questions and personas.
run.noAccessError: You don't have access to this feature.
run.offline: Could not reach the AI assistant. Please try again later.
run.error: Something went wrong while running this step.
run.runsEmptyHint: Create a run to ask every persona the same questions.

export.integrityLine: Simulated personas generated by an LLM for research purposes, not real people.
export.noTranscript: No transcript - run item not completed.
export.noTranscriptError: No transcript - run item not completed (error: {error}).
